;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]]
**Senior [[Syrian Democratic Forces|SDF]] official Redur Xelil says defending [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] prisons is not a priority anymore due to the conflict with [[Turkey]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50029540 (BBC News)]
**Prominent [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish Syrian]] politician [[Hevrin Khalaf]] is dragged from her vehicle on the [[M4 Motorway (Syria)|M4 Motorway]] and summarily executed along with her driver and eight civilians by [[Turkish-backed Free Syrian Army]] militants. The killings were recorded by the militants, which has since been spread on [[social media]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/13/female-kurdish-politician-among-nine-civilians-killed-by-pro-turkey-forces-in-syria-observers-say (''The Guardian'')] 
*[[Terrorism in Kenya]]
**A homemade bomb strikes a [[Kenya Defence Forces|Kenyan military]] vehicle, killing 10. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-security/at-least-10-kenyan-police-killed-by-bomb-near-somali-border-police-idUSKBN1WR0M4 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Ecuadorian protests]]
**President [[Lenín Moreno]] orders [[curfew]] and the militarisation of the capital as civil unrest worsens. [https://www.dw.com/en/ecuador-president-declares-curfew-and-militarization-in-quito/a-50809980 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Shelling in [[Bir Al Abd]], [[Egypt]] kills nine members of the same family. A further six people are wounded. [https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/9-killed-in-explosion-in-north-sinai-1.67105722 (''Gulf News'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A [[Hard Rock Hotel and Casino]] [[1031 Canal|under construction]] in [[New Orleans]] partially collapses, killing one person and injuring at least 18. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/12/us/hard-rock-new-orleans-hotel-collapse.html (''The New York Times'')]
* [[Typhoon Hagibis (2019)|Typhoon Hagibis]] makes landfall in [[Japan]], the biggest storm to hit the region in decades, with over seven million people urged to evacuate. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50020108 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Argentine Foreign Minister [[Jorge Faurie]] announces, the day after Argentina severs diplomatic ties with the government of [[Nicolás Maduro]], that visas granted to the diplomats appointed by Maduro have been revoked and they will be expelled from Argentina; the country now recognizes only [[Juan Guaidó]] appointees. [https://www.clarin.com/politica/canciller-jorge-faurie-confirmo-diplomaticos-nicolas-maduro-deben-irse-pais_0_1rjmjKDU.html (''Clarín'')]
**Border control refuses entry to Venezuela for the [[Guatemala]]n President-Elect [[Alejandro Giammattei]], who was to visit [[Juan Guaidó]] on a diplomatic tour. Giammattei is rerouted to [[Panama]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/7047a7de-ed2a-11e9-ad1e-4367d8281195 (''Financial Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Shooting of Atatiana Jefferson]]
**In [[Fort Worth, Texas]], a woman is shot dead in her bedroom by a policeman sent to check on her welfare. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50032290 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[Eliud Kipchoge]] finishes [[INEOS 1:59 Challenge|a marathon]] in [[Vienna]] in 1 hour, 59 minutes and 40 seconds, assisted by a car and using a fleet of [[Pacemaker_(running)|pacemaker]]s. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/12/sport/eliud-kipchoge-marathon-vienna-intl/index.html (CNN)]
